voices.note: בעו מיניה -- the unnamed askers who put the question to R' Yehoshua ben Levi
דתניא: סככה כהלכתה ועיטרה... -- cited by Rav Yosef (22a.4)

props.gloss_en: is it forbidden to make use of the decorations of a sukka all seven [days]?
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: they already said: it is forbidden to count money opposite the Hanukkah light

the baraita: one who roofed [the sukka] properly and decorated it with hangings and figured sheets and hung in it nuts, peaches, almonds, pomegranates, grape clusters, wreaths of grain, wines, oils and fine flour -- it is forbidden to use them until the end of the last festival day
the baraita: and if he stipulated concerning them, all is according to his stipulation
rather, Rav Yosef said: the father of them all is blood

supports.gloss_en: הרי אמרו אסור להרצות מעות כנגד נר חנוכה -- the sukka decorations are forbidden as the Hanukkah light is

אלא אמר רב יוסף: אבוהון דכולהו דם -- in place of the Hanukkah light, blood is the father of them all
